{{Quote|After the builders left came someone who called himself the Guardian, and he, too, sought control over the native peoples. Finally, the one who called himself the Jedi Master came, and in a battle that lit up the sky he defeated the Guardian. For a time the native peoples thought they might be freed, but the Jedi Master brought humans and native peoples to himself and forced them to live together beneath the shadow of the forbidden mountain. Finally, the Empire has returned.|C-3PO, to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="TLC" />}}
A '''subjugation''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] occured when a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Joruus C'baoth]], the [[Clone madness|insane]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jorus C'baoth]],<ref name="EGtC" /> forced the native [[Myneyrsh]], [[Psadan]], and [[Human/Legends|Human]] populations to live together<ref name="TLC" />&mdash;creating his own [[Joruus C'baoth's kingdom|kingdom]] in the [[Mount Tantiss city|city]] at the base of [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]].<ref name="EGtC" /> At some point during the rule of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the [[Shi'ido]] [[Sentientologist|anthropologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]] mentioned the subjugation in the entires on the Myneyrshi and Psadans in his publication, ''[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''.<ref name="EGtAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>
